name: 分镜出图
description: 人先写好分镜 JSON，image 阶段按每个镜头的 image_prompt 出一张图。自带模板仍然默认用上传的素材；这是可选的生图阶段。用 FLOWGIT_IMAGE_MOCK_DIR 可以不调用接口跑完。 / A person writes the storyboard JSON, then an image stage makes one picture per shot from image_prompt. Bundled templates still default to uploaded assets; this stage is optional. FLOWGIT_IMAGE_MOCK_DIR runs it without calling a vendor.

style.description: 加在每张图提示词前面的画面风格 / Style prepended to every picture prompt
style.default: 干净的插画，柔和的日光

stages.name: 分镜
stages.description: 人工填写 storyboard.json。shots 是数组，每一项有 image_prompt。

executor.instructions: 按 sample 写好 storyboard.json：shots 数组里每一项要有 image_prompt。 / Fill in storyboard.json. Each item of shots needs image_prompt.

outputs.description: 分镜。shots[].image_prompt 是画面描述。 / Storyboard. shots[].image_prompt is the picture description.

stages.name: 画面
stages.description: 每个镜头一张图，写成 shots/001.png、002.png……

outputs.description: 每个镜头一张 PNG。 / One PNG per shot.
